title: About KPGU | Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University
content: , Vadodara. The ingenious efforts of Dr. Kiran C. Patel made the top-ranked US-based university operational under his patronage is set to collaborate with KPGU, Vadodara, and establish Gujarat's first foreign university campus, adhering to international benchmarks and standards, ensuring a bright future for our students. Dr. Kiran C. Patel Hon'ble Vice President, Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara Hon'ble Chairman, Dr. Kiran C.
